writeup: Woot has the new GreenLife Soft Grip 8-piece ceramic nonstick cookware set in turquoise (model CC009158-001, UPC 885837047493) for $47.99. The PFAS-free set includes a 10-inch frypan, a 2-quart saucepan, a 5-quart stockpot, and a 2.5-quart sauté pan. An eBay seller, KT's General Goods, has the same new turquoise 8-piece set with matching MPN CC009158-001 and UPC 885837047493 listed at $146.70, with two available. That is 67 percent below the lowest verified non-Amazon store price and saves about $99. Woot showed 10+ left with a limit of ten per customer.
